Promotional Text: Your recipes, ready to cook. Import from Public Domain Recipes, add your own text or photos, adjust servings, and build your shopping list.
Description:
Keep the recipe. Lose the clutter.

LinkDish brings the recipes you want to cook into one organized cookbook. On iPhone, import recipe links from publicdomainrecipes.com, a public-domain recipe collection. Other websites and social-platform links are not supported in this release. You can also paste recipe text or choose a recipe photo that you created or have permission to use. With your permission, Google Gemini helps turn submitted content into structured ingredients and cooking steps. Always check imported details before cooking.

YOUR COOKBOOK, READY WHEN YOU ARE
Save and edit recipes, keep your own notes, and find a favorite when it is time to cook.

COOK WITH CLEAR STEPS
Follow focused cooking instructions, check off ingredients, and use timers when a recipe includes them.

MAKE THE RIGHT AMOUNT
Adjust servings and add ingredients to a shopping list so you can plan the next meal.

TRY LINKDISH FREE
Start with 3 recipe imports total and save up to 15 personal recipes. LinkDish Plus Monthly includes 100 recipe imports each month and unlimited personal recipe saves. Sign in to subscribe or restore purchases.

Import only content you created or have permission to process with LinkDish and Google Gemini. A screenshot does not remove source restrictions. Link imports currently omit website artwork; you can add your own recipe photos. Import results depend on the content provided.

Plus Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription. The current price and billing period are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel your subscription in App Store account settings.

Notes:
LinkDish organizes recipes into a personal cookbook. Build 39 uses the production API at api.linkdish.ca and production Clerk authentication.

Basic review: open Add, acknowledge the Google Gemini disclosure, and paste your own recipe text or use https://publicdomainrecipes.com/basic-waffles/. iPhone link imports use the restricted /extract/ios endpoint; only publicdomainrecipes.com recipe pages are currently supported. Unsupported websites/social links are rejected before extraction. The server checks redirects and linked-page fetches, checks robots.txt, disables browser/video fallbacks and bypasses the unrestricted result cache. Remote website artwork is omitted. Save the imported recipe, open it from Cookbook, adjust servings, use Cook mode, and add ingredients to Shopping. Photo imports are available from Add. Uploaded photos/text must be owned or permitted by the user. Imported content should be checked for accuracy. Publisher reuse basis: https://github.com/ronaldl29/public-domain-recipes#license .

Subscription review: sign in, then open Account > View plans. This iOS release offers only LinkDish Plus Monthly (linkdish_plus_monthly): 100 recipe imports/month and unlimited personal recipe saves. The free plan includes 3 recipe imports total and up to 15 personal recipes. Restore purchases and Manage subscription are available in the app. Existing Family entitlements remain recognized, but Family and yearly plans are not offered for new purchase on iOS.

Account deletion is available from Account. The app does not require a local development server.
